next.reason: 1985: a numeric PICTURE contains only '9', 'P', 'S', 'V' and 'The number of digit positions ... must range from 1 to 18 inclusive'; content numeric characters plus an operational sign if signed. 2023: §2023:13.18.40.4 GR11 (at least one '9', may contain 'P', 'S', 'V') and §2023:13.18.40.4 GR14 ('9' 'shall contain a numeric character in the range 0 through 9 with the possible inclusion of an operational sign') keep the symbol set and content, but §2023:13.18.40.3 SR14 sets 'from 1 through 31' digit positions: 19 to 31 digit numeric PICTUREs refused in 1985 are accepted.
